index.summary: The story of how the world's largest entrepreneurial network came to North Bengal — our chapter, our people and our mandate.

mission.headline: Helping entrepreneurs become better entrepreneurs
body: TiE Siliguri is the North Bengal chapter of TiE — a global movement built to help founders learn faster, grow further and reach opportunities that would otherwise stay out of reach.
We operate as a Spoke Chapter under TiE Kolkata, bringing a proven playbook of mentoring, learning, networking, funding and incubation to Siliguri and the wider region.

tieGlobal.title: The world's largest network of entrepreneurs
tieGlobal.summary: Founded in Silicon Valley in 1992, TiE — The Indus Entrepreneurs — exists for one purpose: to help entrepreneurs become better entrepreneurs.
tieGlobal.imageAlt: TiE Global — a worldwide network reaching India and North Bengal
intro: TiE was born in 1992 when a group of successful entrepreneurs and professionals of Indus origin came together in Silicon Valley to give back — to mentor the next generation the way they wished they had been mentored.

Three decades on, that idea has become a global institution: a non-profit network that turns the hard-won experience of established founders into a structured advantage for the ones coming up behind them.

india.headline: The largest founder network in the country
body: India is home to the largest concentration of TiE chapters anywhere in the world — 32 active chapters and counting, from the metros to fast-rising Tier 2 and Tier 3 cities.
TiE Siliguri joins that map as North Bengal's chapter, mentored by TiE Kolkata — one of the network's most active and respected chapters, founded in 2002.

ourChapter.title: TiE comes to North Bengal
ourChapter.summary: Launched on 30 July 2025 as a Spoke Chapter under TiE Kolkata, TiE Siliguri exists to put North Bengal firmly on India's entrepreneurial map.

purpose.headline: What we are here to do
items: Create a trusted platform for entrepreneurs, investors, professionals and students to connect and grow together.
Bridge the knowledge and network gap between local entrepreneurs and global opportunities.
Mentor and handhold first-generation founders who often lack structured support in Tier 2 and Tier 3 cities.
Bring global best practices to the region while keeping our local entrepreneurial strengths and culture alive.

hub.headline: Mentored by TiE Kolkata
body: As per TiE Global policy, every new chapter begins as a Spoke Chapter under an established Hub Chapter for its first two years. TiE Kolkata — founded in 2002, with 125+ Charter Members and 300+ Associate Members — is our Hub.

That means Kolkata mentors, guides and supports us in setting up governance, programs, events and membership, so the chapter is built on a proven foundation. Once we meet TiE Global's criteria, TiE Siliguri applies for full independent chapter status.

chapterManager.title: The team behind the chapter
chapterManager.summary: Every TiE chapter runs on a small operational team that keeps the mission moving — the first people you talk to as a member or a prospective one.
intro: The Chapter Manager is your day-to-day point of contact at TiE Siliguri. Where the Executive Committee sets direction, the manager makes it happen — coordinating events, onboarding members, answering questions and keeping the chapter running smoothly.
Whether you are weighing up membership, planning to attend an event, or want to get involved as a volunteer or partner, this is the desk to reach.

items: Membership enquiries, applications and onboarding for Charter and Associate Members.
Event scheduling, registrations and logistics across the monthly calendar.
The link between members and the Executive Committee.
Coordination with our Hub Chapter, TiE Kolkata, and the wider TiE Global network.
